title: Melanoid Axolotls x Fresh Animations
description: Adds compatibility with Melanoid Axolotls (By Konci) & Fresh Animations (By FreshLX)
body:
A Resource Pack that adds compatibility bettween Konci's Melanoid Axolotls and FreshLX's Fresh Animations (Fresh Animations is required along with its required mods)



Note: I do not own Melanoid Axolotls OR Fresh Animations, they belong to their respective creators and this is just a compatibility pack
